---
title: "Press: Winter Bill-Change Bar Charts"
format: html
---

Bar charts summarizing the change in total winter energy bills after switching
to a heat pump from natural gas, for all households in MA. Intended for press
use — a simplified alternative to the full histograms.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import polars as pl
import plotnine as plt

from lib.plotnine import theme_switchbox
from lib.rates_analysis.rate_case_funcs import (
    QUADRANT_COLORS,
    QUADRANT_ORDER,
    _quadrant_seg_label_df,
)

TITLE = (
    "Change in total winter energy bills after switching to a heat pump\n"
    "from natural gas, for all households in MA"
)

ALL_ROWS: list[tuple[str, dict[str, float]]] = [
    (
        "Default Rates",
        {"savings > $1k": 0.6, "savings $0-1k": 23.2, "losses $0-1k": 44.5, "losses > $1k": 31.7},
    ),
    (
        "Current HP Rates",
        {"savings > $1k": 1.9, "savings $0-1k": 37.3, "losses $0-1k": 37.6, "losses > $1k": 23.2},
    ),
    (
        "Increased HP Rates",
        {"savings > $1k": 3.8, "savings $0-1k": 46.7, "losses $0-1k": 33.7, "losses > $1k": 15.7},
    ),
    (
        "State's Proposed HP Rates",
        {"savings > $1k": 8.4, "savings $0-1k": 62.3, "losses $0-1k": 21.5, "losses > $1k": 7.8},
    ),
]


def plot_quadrant_bars(
    rows: list[tuple[str, dict[str, float]]],
    title: str,
) -> plt.ggplot:
    """Horizontal stacked bar chart of bill-change quadrants from hardcoded pcts."""
    records: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    all_pcts: list[dict[str, float]] = []
    for row_label, pct in rows:
        all_pcts.append(pct)
        for q in QUADRANT_ORDER:
            records.append({"scenario": row_label, "quadrant": q, "pct": pct[q]})

    scenario_order = [r[0] for r in reversed(rows)]
    plot_df = pl.DataFrame(records).with_columns(
        pl.col("quadrant").cast(pl.Enum(QUADRANT_ORDER)),
        pl.col("scenario").cast(pl.Enum(scenario_order)),
    )

    n_scenarios = len(rows)
    seg_label_df = _quadrant_seg_label_df(all_pcts)

    row_label_records: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for i, (row_label, _) in enumerate(rows):
        bar_pos = n_scenarios - i
        row_label_records.append({"x": bar_pos, "y": 101, "label": row_label})
    row_label_df = pl.DataFrame(row_label_records)

    p = (
        plt.ggplot(plot_df, plt.aes(x="scenario", y="pct", fill="quadrant"))
        + plt.geom_col(position="stack", width=0.55)
        + plt.geom_text(
            mapping=plt.aes(label="pct"),
            data=plot_df.filter(pl.col("pct") >= 3),
            position=plt.position_stack(vjust=0.5),
            format_string="{:.1f}%",
            color="white",
            size=11,
            fontweight="bold",
        )
        + plt.scale_fill_manual(values=QUADRANT_COLORS, breaks=QUADRANT_ORDER)
        + plt.scale_y_continuous(expand=(0, 0, 0.32, 0))
        + plt.scale_x_discrete(expand=(0, 0.35, 0, 0.7))
        + plt.coord_flip()
        + plt.guides(fill=False)
        + plt.labs(x="", y="", title=title)
        + theme_switchbox()
        + plt.theme(
            figure_size=(13.5, max(3.2, 1.0 + 1.4 * n_scenarios)),
            axis_text=plt.element_blank(),
            axis_ticks_x=plt.element_blank(),
            axis_ticks_y=plt.element_blank(),
            axis_line_x=plt.element_blank(),
            axis_line_y=plt.element_blank(),
            panel_grid=plt.element_blank(),
            plot_title=plt.element_text(ha="left", margin={"b": -8, "unit": "pt"}),
        )
    )

    if seg_label_df is not None:
        for ha_val in seg_label_df["ha"].unique().to_list():
            sub = seg_label_df.filter(pl.col("ha") == ha_val)
            p = p + plt.geom_text(
                mapping=plt.aes(x="x", y="y", label="label", color="color"),
                data=sub,
                ha=ha_val,
                va="bottom",
                size=10,
                fontweight="bold",
                inherit_aes=False,
                show_legend=False,
            )
        p = p + plt.scale_color_identity()

    p = p + plt.geom_text(
        mapping=plt.aes(x="x", y="y", label="label"),
        data=row_label_df,
        ha="left",
        va="center",
        size=11,
        fontweight="bold",
        inherit_aes=False,
    )

    return p
```

## Default through Increased HP Rates

```{python}
#| label: fig-winter-bill-bars-through-increased
#| fig-cap: "Change in total winter energy bills after switching to a heat pump from natural gas, for all households in MA. Default Rates through Increased HP Rates."

plot_quadrant_bars(ALL_ROWS[:3], title=TITLE)
```

## Default through State's Proposed HP Rates

```{python}
#| label: fig-winter-bill-bars-through-proposed
#| fig-cap: "Change in total winter energy bills after switching to a heat pump from natural gas, for all households in MA. All four rate scenarios."

plot_quadrant_bars(ALL_ROWS, title=TITLE)
```
